name: Sync Custom Object Records (create/update)
summary: Creates or updates records on a custom object type. One row per record, matched by the object's dedupe field.
whenToUse: When you have per-lead custom data (e.g. a person's car VIN + details) to create or refresh in Marketo. Up to 300 per call.

path.name: apiName
path.label: Object API name
path.hint: The object type's API name — find it via List Custom Objects.

body.hint: One row per record. Include the object's dedupe field (see Describe Custom Object — e.g. vin) so Marketo can match existing records, plus the field values to set.

response.description: Per row: marketoGUID, status (created/updated/failed), and the row sequence number.

notes: This call can take up to 2 minutes server-side — patience on large batches.
Check the object's Describe response for the exact dedupe field and allowed field names.
